description: Which fixed connections reach a Dutch address: fiber, coax (cable) and copper (DSL), with the network owner, line speed and any network fee. Every listed connection is at the address. state "present" means the line is in the meter closet and can be ordered on; say so plainly, as the site does, and do not call it unconfirmed or unknown. Fiber can also be "connected", "planned", "in_street", "awaiting_connection" or "new_build". Use stateDescription and summary as given. Welke kabels er op een adres liggen, en of glasvezel aangesloten of gepland is.

huisnummer.description: House number, e.g. 12. A suffix like "12A" or "12-2" is split into toevoeging.

postcode.description: Dutch postcode, four digits and two letters, e.g. "1234AB" or "1234 AB".

toevoeging.description: House number addition such as "A", "2" or "bis". Omit when there is none.

name: aansluitingen
